study_identification_part.si3_author_journal_year: Segal et al., Biological Psychiatry: Cognitive Neuroscience and Neuroimaging, 2025
study_identification_part.si4_title: Multiscale Heterogeneity of White Matter Morphometry in Psychiatric Disorders

cm1_research_objectives.reason: The paper clearly states objectives: to assess whether voxelwise WMV deviations are heterogeneous across individuals and whether deviations aggregate within common tracts, regions, and networks. It also states the purpose of applying normative modeling (to map person-specific deviations and characterize heterogeneity across spatial scales). Both criteria are satisfied.
cm1_research_objectives.supporting_text: "We applied warped Bayesian linear regression normative models to T1-weighted magnetic resonance imaging data and mapped interindividual variability in person-specific white matter volume (WMV) deviations... We developed a framework to characterize deviation heterogeneity on multiple spatial scales..."; "Specifically, we set out to test the hypothesis that although deviations may occur in distinct regions of white matter, they nonetheless will implicate common white matter tracts and/or affect similar brain regions or extended networks."

nm1_selection_criteria_reference_cohort.reason: This is a new normative model. The study describes eligibility criteria and exclusions for the healthy reference cohort (age 18–64; remove missing demographics; preprocessing failures; manual/automated QC failures; minimum per-site sample), specifies image quality standards (manual and automated QC; preprocessing pass), and reports final sample sizes and reasons for exclusion. The original sources for open datasets are cited.
nm1_selection_criteria_reference_cohort.supporting_text: "We excluded participants who: – Were below 18 years or above 64 years... – Lacked the necessary clinical data... or demographic information (age and sex)... – T1-weighted MRI scans failed the preprocessing pipeline... – ...did not pass our rigorous manual and automated quality control procedures... – Were from sites with fewer than 10 individuals in the same group and sex... Thus, our final sample... included 1,465 controls and 1,294 cases."

nm2_handling_of_covariates_reference_coh.reason: Age is modeled nonlinearly using B-splines; sex is included as a covariate (stated in figure caption and methods); and multi-site effects are addressed by including scan site as a covariate. This satisfies both covariate criteria.
nm2_handling_of_covariates_reference_coh.supporting_text: "B-spline basis expansion over age was used to model non-linear effects... To handle the site effect, we included scan site as a covariate."; "...train a normative model to make voxelwise WMV predictions given someone's age, sex, and scan site."

nm3_data_sources_reference_cohort.reason: The data sources for the reference cohort are clearly described: 14 datasets across 25 sites are listed, and availability/citations are provided (e.g., ABIDE, ASRB, HCP, OpenNeuro datasets).
nm3_data_sources_reference_cohort.supporting_text: "This study included 3746 individuals... from 14 separate, independently acquired dataset and 25 scan sites."; "Summary of data availability for each dataset used in this study is described below. ABIDE I... ASRB... HCP... OpenNeuro..."

nm4_image_acquisition_protocol.reason: Per guide: for secondary data (existing datasets), answer NA. Image acquisition parameters are referenced to prior publications and not newly acquired in this study.
nm4_image_acquisition_protocol.supporting_text: "...image acquisition parameters for each dataset provided in Table S1 in Segal et al. (1)."

nm5_data_preprocessing.reason: Preprocessing is described in detail: CAT12 r113 in SPM12 (MATLAB v9.8), bias correction, tissue segmentation, spatial normalization to SPM MNI IXI555, modulation, 8mm FWHM smoothing, and WM mask thresholding. Quality control procedures (manual and automated) are specified.
nm5_data_preprocessing.supporting_text: "WMV was estimated using the Computational Anatomy Toolbox (CAT12 r113)... in SPM12 in MATLAB v9.8... corrected for bias-field... segmented... spatially normalised... modulated and spatially smoothed with an 8mm FWHM Gaussian... retained voxels with a tissue probability ≥ 0.2."; "...did not pass our rigorous manual and automated quality control procedures..."

nm6_internal_data_validation_reference_c.reason: A held-out control set (HCtest) is used for validation, separate from the training controls (HCtrain). This constitutes internal validation via a hold-out partition.
nm6_internal_data_validation_reference_c.supporting_text: "The training set (HCtrain, n = 1,465)... The test set consisted of all clinical data... as well as the remaining controls from each scan site (HCtest, n = 269)."

nm7_external_data_validation_reference_c.reason: No application of the normative model to an independent external healthy dataset is described beyond the held-out controls drawn from the same multi-site pool. No separate external HC dataset is reported.
nm7_external_data_validation_reference_c.supporting_text: "The test set consisted of... the remaining controls from each scan site (HCtest)." (no mention of an independent external HC dataset)

nm8_normative_modeling_approach.reason: The modeling approach is described: warped Bayesian linear regression with B-spline basis over age, likelihood warping for non-Gaussian/heteroscedasticity, and site as covariate. However, software/libraries used for implementation of the normative modeling are not explicitly specified.
nm8_normative_modeling_approach.supporting_text: "We applied warped Bayesian linear regression normative models..."; "B-spline basis expansion over age was used... likelihood warping was used... included scan site as a covariate."

nm9_model_performance_reference_cohort.reason: Model performance is quantitatively evaluated using EV, SMSE, MSLL, skew, and kurtosis, with poor voxels removed. Additional SVM analyses demonstrate low residual site effects.
nm9_model_performance_reference_cohort.supporting_text: "We assessed model fit... five performance metrics: (i) explained variance (EV); (ii) SMSE; (iii) MSLL; (iv) skew; and (v) kurtosis... We removed voxels with poor performance... We also evaluated the model's efficacy... using ... SVM... balanced accuracy close to chance-level (50%) indicates..."
